title: The Red Seal / 红色封印

creative.logline: 一位孤独的侦探在深夜打开威胁信，门外似乎有人先他一步知道了秘密。
creative.emotion_arc: 孤独 → 察觉危险 → 悬念
creative.visual_bible: 1940s-inspired noir; deep cyan shadows, warm amber practical lamp, fine grain, restrained camera movement; same desk, window on frame-right, door on frame-left.

beats.goal: 建立侦探孤独且封闭的空间
以信封红印章作为危险信息的焦点
门把手的动作制造未解决的威胁

assets.description: Middle-aged detective with neat dark hair and charcoal trench coat
Small 1940s private-detective office; door screen-left, desk center, window screen-right
Ivory envelope with one dark-red wax seal, no legible writing

shots.story_purpose: 建立冷清的办公室以及孤独的侦探
shots.action: 侦探独坐书桌前，从桌面缓缓拿起一封未拆的信。
shots.composition: door frame-left, detective center, rainy window frame-right
shots.lighting: warm desk lamp camera-left, cold rain reflections from window camera-right

continuity.exit: detective lifts envelope in right hand

shots.prompt: 5-second single wide locked-off noir shot in a small office: door on screen-left, desk at center, rainy window on screen-right. The same detective with dark hair and a charcoal trench coat sits, then slowly lifts an ivory envelope with one red seal in his right hand. Warm amber desk lamp from camera-left, cold cyan rain reflection from camera-right. Quiet unease, fine grain, no sudden cuts.

shots.story_purpose: 把观众注意力缩到危险线索
shots.action: 右手握住信封，拇指停在红色蜡封上方。
shots.composition: seal centered, right hand enters from lower-right
shots.lighting: same amber lamp on left, soft cyan edge reflection on right
shots.palette: ivory, deep red, warm amber, cyan black

continuity.entry: envelope held in detective's right hand
continuity.exit: thumb suspended just above the red wax seal

shots.prompt: 5-second insert close-up, consistent ivory envelope with a single dark-red wax seal in the detective's right hand. He lifts his thumb toward the seal then pauses before touching it. Slow subtle dolly-in, 85mm-equivalent portrait compression, f/4-look so the seal remains sharp. The same amber desk lamp illuminates from frame-left, cyan rainy highlights from frame-right. One continuous action, no invented writing.

shots.story_purpose: 通过门把手制造被窥视的压迫感
shots.action: 侦探抬眼看向画面左侧的门，门把手缓缓转动。
shots.composition: detective foreground right; door frame-left visible behind
shots.lighting: warm desk practical still camera-left; brief cool sweep across face
shots.sound: rain fades under a single metallic door-handle click

continuity.entry: detective seated with letter held in right hand
continuity.exit: detective gazes at door, door handle begins turning

shots.prompt: 5-second medium close-up in the SAME small noir office. Detective remains seated at the desk, keeping the same ivory sealed envelope in his right hand. He slowly raises his eyes toward the door on screen-left. In background the door handle begins a small rotation; cut before it opens. Locked-off camera, warm lamp camera-left and restrained cyan rain reflection. Unresolved suspense, controlled human performance.

assumptions: No reference imagery was provided; assets are planned descriptions, not generated media.
